purpose: Consolidate duplicated output buffer filesystem guard code between the legacy template_redirect path and the WP 6.9+ template enhancement path, adding a deprecation notice for the legacy path.
riskRationale: Deletes vendor/composer/platform_check.php (PHP 8.2+ version/extension enforcement) — a deployment-safety regression — and fires _doing_it_wrong() on every front-end page load for 100% of current installs since WP 6.9 is unreleased.
breakingChanges: vendor/composer/platform_check.php removed — drops Composer's PHP 8.2+ platform enforcement
_doing_it_wrong() fires on every template_redirect invocation, affecting all current WP installations

text: The core refactoring (save_processed_buffer extraction, comment additions) is clean and well-executed. However, the PR is contaminated with unrelated vendor file changes that actively degrade deployment safety, and the deprecation notice placement is too aggressive for an unreleased target version.
strengths: includes/class-cache.php:644 — save_processed_buffer() cleanly extracts the duplicated get_filesystem() + prepare_cache_dir() guard into a single shared private method
includes/class-main.php:217 — Inline comments clearly disambiguate the WP 6.9+ vs legacy branching for future maintainers

reasoning: Contains a critical regression in vendor/ (platform check removed) and an overly aggressive deprecation notice that fires on every page load. Core refactor is sound but these issues block merge.

message: save_processed_buffer() cleanly extracts the duplicated get_filesystem() + prepare_cache_dir() guard into a single shared private method — DRY improvement with no behavioral change.
Inline comments clearly disambiguate the WP 6.9+ vs legacy branching for future maintainers.

platform_check.php deleted — removes Composer's PHP 8.2+ version/extension enforcement. If deployed to a server running PHP <8.2, the plugin will fail with a cryptic PHP fatal error instead of Composer's friendly platform error. Completely unrelated to the PR purpose.
suggestion: Restore platform_check.php and the require line in autoload_real.php. If a newer Composer version regenerates without it, ensure composer.json platform config or the build process preserves the check.
suggestionCode: git checkout HEAD~1 -- vendor/composer/platform_check.php vendor/composer/autoload_real.php vendor/composer/installed.php

message: _doing_it_wrong() fires on every front-end page load via template_redirect. Since WP 6.9 has not been released as stable, 100% of current installations hit this path. On sites with WP_DEBUG enabled, this generates a PHP notice on every page view — cluttering error logs and potentially breaking API/AJAX responses.
suggestion: Scope the deprecation notice to only fire in admin context or when the new WP 6.9+ API function actually exists (since the legacy path is only taken when it doesn't). A better approach: show an admin notice on the plugin settings page instead, or wrap in is_admin() check.

message: save_cache_files() internally calls prepare_cache_dir() again (line 618), which is redundant since save_processed_buffer() already calls it as a guard. This double call pre-existed the refactor, but the refactor was the right opportunity to clean it up.
suggestion: Remove the internal prepare_cache_dir() call from save_cache_files() since all callers now go through save_processed_buffer() which already ensures the directory exists. Or document the idempotency.
